body: The cool metal surface of the door felt inviting as my fingers brushed against its smooth edge. I couldn't help but wonder if something was hidden inside or perhaps left behind after being used. My curiosity piqued, I cautiously approached the door, each step bringing me nearer to whatever secrets lay within.
